sum(row(...))
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=80

You are right. It was my problem because I was compiling stan and the model
with non default flags. The issue seems to be because I compiled stan and
the model with the CFLAG -fopenmp (since Eigen has some limited
parallelization if it is compiled with it). Somehow openmp creates the
crazy mess of the error I reported. I had thought that enabling openmp was
a costless way to get a speed up, and it had worked until now. It might be
nice to support it, although it will only speed up matrix multiplication.

Comment #3 on issue 80 by ca...@alias-i.com: Unusual error with sum(row(...))
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=80

I'm going to close this issue.

Unfortunately, that won't speed up any matrix multiplication involving a
parameter, transformed parameter, or local model variable. The problem is
that these involve stan::agrad::var types.

We do eventually plan to reduce many of the matrix operations to doubles,
but that probably still won't help multiplication much.
